title: 安里屋ユンタ (Asadoya Yunta — The Asadoya Work Song)
description: A traditional Yaeyama Islands work song (ユンタ) from Taketomi Island, Okinawa, about the historical beauty Asadoya Kuyama who bravely rejected the advances of a government official. Sung in the ancient Yaeyama dialect of Ryukyuan, the original folk version preserves the actual island story. Note: the famous 1934 'New Asadoya Yunta' has entirely different modern lyrics — this entry uses the traditional original.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Yaeyama folk song from Taketomi Island; origins in Ryukyu Kingdom era)
